instruction: A candid medium full shot captures a positive interaction in a martial arts studio with a brick wall background decorated with two framed Japanese paintings. On the left, the bearded instructor with a headband (R6) wearing a black gi stands with his back mostly to the camera, raising his right hand. On the right, the young boy with light brown hair (R2) wearing a white gi stands facing left, raising his hand to high-five the instructor. The two are smiling and celebrating a successful practice session. Bright indoor lighting fills the space, highlighting the warm tones of the brick wall.
